name: Dried seaweed
summary: Dried seaweed, one of the island’s take-home foods, sold beside the fish sauce and pepper at the Dinh Cậu night market.
origin: Phu Quoc, on the night account.
howToEat: Buy it at the night market to take home.
where: The Dinh Cậu night market, where the streets close to traffic from 5 pm until midnight.
seoTitle: Dried seaweed at the Dinh Cau night market
seoDescription: Dried seaweed is one of Phu Quoc’s take-home foods, sold at the Dinh Cậu night market.
